lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 distinct vertical white lines traversing the lateral torso from the shoulder to the hindquarters; spacing is relatively uniform in the mid-section (~50-70 pixels) with increased spacing between the final two posterior lines.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The vertical lines located on the mid-posterior flank exhibit visible fragmentation, appearing as dashed segments rather than continuous lines from the dorsal ridge to the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 5-6 distinct white spots is visible on the lower haunch area, situated between the final vertical line and the tail base.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the upper hind limb align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric marker posterior to the main torso line sequence.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white markings are visible on the lower limbs (socks) and a distinct white spot is present on the muzzle area between the eye and the nose.
